texts.text: 17-13-0303-C (1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans - Zoning Map Amendment 1138 North California Avenue, Chicago, Illinois Proposed Zoning: B3-1 Community Shopping District Lot Area: 3,017.64 square feet (as dimensioned) / 3,018 square feet (per survey) Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a Type I Zoning Map Amendment with Variation, pursuant to Section 17-13-0300 of the current Chicago Zoning Ordinance, in order to permit the issuance of a public place of amusement (PPA) license for the existing community live theatre that operates at the subject property, which such PPA license will allow for the theatre to charge and to accept an admittance fee for their live performances. No new construction or other changes to the physicality or use / operation of the existing two-story and one-story conjoined building are intended or contemplated. The existing second-floor dwelling unit, therefore and accordingly, will remain unchanged. There is and will remain no off-street parking at, servicing or required for the subject property. The existing building is, and will remain, masonry in construction, with a frame fagade on the ground floor, and will continue to measure 26 feet-8 inches in height (to top of parapet) at its tallest point. The sole reason for the rezoning and related relief is to allow for the issuance of a PPA license for the existing live theatre venue, due to the site’s proximity to an RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District. (A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: +/- 3,500 square feet (1.16 FAR) (Existing / Proposed) (B) The Projects Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 1 unit / 3,018 square feet (Existing / Proposed) (C) The amount of off-street parking: 0 automobile spaces / 0 bicycle spaces (Existing / Proposed) *The existing live theatre venue has less than 150 seats, and ~ therefore, no off-street parking is required. [Sec. 17-10-0207-P] Furthermore, the subject property is located within 1,320 linear feet of a designated CTA Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment Pursuant to Section and the existing building and residential use has been in lawful existence for more than 50 years. As such, no parking is required for the existing and unchanged dwelling unit. [Sec. 17-10-0101-B and Sec. 17-10-0102-B\ (D) _ Setbacks: (Existing / Proposed) a. Front Setback: 0 feet-0 inches b.
